data.narrative:
Svante is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised $318M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 peer companies—1 public (Lnza) and 8 private—including names such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. A narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the target valuation tier; only 2 adjacent-stage peers were identified, falling short of the 3-datapoint threshold needed for reliable triangulation.

The stage-progression method was therefore applied as the primary valuation technique. Using the $318M total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.4x multiplier—typical for Series E advancement—yields an implied valuation of $445M. This method rests on the assumption that Series E step-ups in the climate-tech sector follow historical patterns and that total raised correlates appropriately with post-money valuations at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a median valuation of $445M, with a low estimate of $378M (representing downside sensitivity to slower-than-typical step-up rates) and a high estimate of $512M (reflecting upside if growth outpaces sector median). Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables, reliance on a single methodological anchor, and the inherent volatility of private climate-tech valuations. Further precision would require either expanded peer sets or proprietary transaction data from recent Series E/F financings in this subsector.
